findings.text: reckon/run_store.py:280 blocking: `_row_revision` stamps a row's revision from the record's `promoted_revision`, but reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:305 defines that field as the tip of the run's own work resolved in the run tree and states that the commit the promotion makes — the one carrying the ledger row — is deliberately a different commit; so every promotion-written row carries a sha that is not the commit its record file entered the tree at, contrary to the column's own declaration at reckon/run_store.py:59-66 and to velocity's use of it as a revision to read that file at (reckon/velocity.py:823-834, where read_blobs answers `missing` and the row silently falls back to the durable payload the change was written to supplement). `RunStore.revisionless_rows` (reckon/run_store.py:941) selects only NULL or empty, so `backfill_revisions` never repairs a wrong stamp — a probe against the head stamped `{'r-1': 'deadbeefcafe'}` from a record carrying that promoted_revision and reported no revisionless rows. Repair by stamping nothing on the promotion path and letting the backfill place the row, or by recording which of the two facts the value holds.

reckon/velocity.py:1904 non-blocking: `_landed_in_window` accepts the committed `promoted_revision` marker only when `record_source == "committed_primary_snapshot"`, and the change introduces the two sources `run_store_record_revision` and `run_store_row` at reckon/velocity.py:1085 for rows it reads partly from that same committed record; those rows therefore never count as landed and `coordinator_cost`'s `landed_nodes` under-counts under the store path the change exists to survive.

reckon/run_store.py:1142 non-blocking: `_record_file_revisions` duplicates an existing mechanism rather than extending its owner — reckon/velocity.py:1294 `_record_file_additions` already runs the same first-parent, `--diff-filter=A`, `--name-only`, `%x1e`-delimited log over `docs/state/<project>/runs` and maps a run id to the commit that added its file; the two differ in helper (subprocess here, velocity's `git()` there) and in whether epoch is carried, so the repository now holds two scans for one fact.

docs/figures/plan-review-cycles/measure_review_cycles.py:71 non-blocking: the commit carries roughly sixty lines of formatter reflow unrelated to the store read — the INVARIANT_EXEMPT reflow here, the `ax.tick_params` reindent at 1074, the `reviews_baseline_600s` and `lost.extend` reflows further down — which the repository's rule puts in its own `style(lint):` commit with nothing else in it, so this diff carries work the goal does not imply.

logs/red-at-base.log:3 non-blocking: the base arm's extraction sits at `/tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/<run>/base-s24`, a bare `/tmp` path, where the dispatch rule puts a temporary tree under `$TMPDIR` so it dies with the run's scratch and cannot collide with another run's tree.
